Rules 1, 2, 5, 6, 9: repeated separators, empty quotes and ordinary-whitespace-only labels disappear.

Rules 1, 2, 8: commas in quoted segments are literals, including a comma-only label.

Rules 1, 2, 3, 8: escaped commas, quotes, backslashes and uppercase letters stay literal in quoted mode without changing mode.
Rules 3, 8: a backslash preserves exactly the following character, without interpreting letter escapes as control characters.

Rules 6, 7: ordinary runs between protected edge spaces and letters are internal and collapse instead of being trimmed.
Rules 2, 3, 6, 8, 10: deduplicate only after trimming, lowercasing and removing quote and escape syntax, retaining first occurrence order.
Rules 6, 7, 8, 10: protected leading and trailing spaces distinguish labels; equivalent quoted and escaped boundaries deduplicate.

cases.intent: Rule 8: preserve non-delimiter punctuation and digits exactly while lowercasing every ASCII uppercase letter.
Rules 4, 9, 10: an outside trailing backslash rejects the whole input despite earlier valid, empty and duplicate labels.
Rules 3, 4: a trailing unpaired backslash inside an unclosed quoted label rejects the whole input after a valid label.
Rules 2, 4, 9, 10: opening a quote in the middle of a later label without closing it invalidates the entire input.
Rules 3, 4: an escaped final quote is literal and leaves quoted mode unclosed, invalidating an otherwise valid prefix.

rationale: The 24 distinct ASCII cases cover all ten rules and their interactions. Expectations apply left-to-right quote and escape parsing before provenance-aware ordinary whitespace trimming and collapse, then ASCII lowercasing, empty removal and stable exact-string deduplication. All six whitespace characters appear as ordinary, quoted and individually escaped characters. Empty quote segments contribute no characters; protected whitespace breaks ordinary runs and remains significant at boundaries. Delimiters and escaped literals are exercised in both modes. Four malformed suffix cases require whole-input ValueError, represented by null, even after valid labels. No Unicode or non-string inputs are included.
